name: Generic - Workflow B — Categorize, Load & Publish copy

nodes.name: Parse & Insert Categories
nodes.notes: Parses the services string and prepares one item per category pair for the next node to resolve UUIDs.

nodes.name: Resolve Sub-Category UUIDs
nodes.notes: Looks up the UUID for each sub/subsub category name. Uses subsub_name if available, otherwise sub_name.

nodes.name: Insert Listing Categories
nodes.notes: Inserts one row per category pair into listing_categories. continueOnFail=true so an unresolved category name doesn't stop the whole workflow.

nodes.name: Publish to BD API
nodes.notes: Publishes the listing to Brilliant Directories via the BD API. Stops workflow on failure.

nodes.name: Update Supabase with BD Member ID
Update Import Batch Counts
nodes.notes: Updates the import_batches record with how many listings were published. continueOnFail=true so a missing batch ID doesn't block the completion email.

## Begin Updates of Supabase and Brilliant Directories
** This will read from spreadsheet which should have all info to go to BD, including logo image thumbnail URLs for import, which was a manual step and reason for two different workflows.
** Final outcome of this workflow should be all uploaded to BD, at which point, the listing image fetch and re-size function may be run, completing the update.
